author: kirubaharan181
description: Handles support tiers, fixes, patches, updates and enhancements. Use when maintaining live software. Do NOT use for new product build.
purpose: Keeps live software healthy after release: tiered support, bug fixing, patching, dependency updates, database maintenance, performance and debt work, enhancements, feedback, knowledge base, maintenance releases and lifecycle decisions. It owns stages 167-180.
when_to_use: Support requests, bugs or patches need handling.
Dependencies, performance or technical debt need planned work.
A lifecycle or retirement decision for a product is needed.
when_not_to_use: Building a new product: use requirements-design and software-implementation.
Running an active major incident: use incident-command.
prerequisites: A ticket system and the escalation rules.
Access to runbooks and the knowledge base.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: resolved or escalated tickets with full records
bug fixes and patches with tests

decision_rules.action: Apply it and confirm with the user.
Escalate with the full record so the user does not repeat details.
Prioritize by severity and exposure and record the deadline.
Require notice, migration path and sponsor approval.

quality_gates: Tickets carry identifiers, steps and time
Fixes are confirmed with the user
Retirement has notice and data handling

examples.title: Escalate a ticket
examples.request: User cannot download invoices; L1 has no fix.
examples.context: Account id and error time are known.
examples.behavior: Escalate with the account id, error time, steps and impact, and tell the user the next update time.
examples.output: L2 ticket with complete record and user update.
examples.acceptance: The user is not asked to repeat details.

examples.title: Plan a dependency update
examples.request: A library has a critical vulnerability.
examples.behavior: Find affected services, update with tests, plan staged rollout and rollback, and record the deadline.

limitations: Cannot see customer systems it has no access to.
Does not approve production patches: a named human does.
Root cause may need tiers beyond its access.

troubleshooting.resolution: Link to the known issue and update the user.
Roll back and add characterization tests.

handoffs.artifact: defects and enhancements with reproduction steps
